experiment: Synthetic eight-map differential CMB calibration; bin-level Wishart ensemble
scope: No measured sky data. Exact Wishart draws at weighted bin-mean covariance; not an exact ell-level simulation.

generation_benchmark.scope: CPU Bartlett and selected-device Gram produce the same bin-level Wishart distribution and output shape using different algorithms and random streams; no hardware speedup claim.

acceptance.mcse_method: Independent simulation clusters; delta method for centered pull width; empirical SEM for chi-square means.

device.name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070
device.backend: PyTorch 2.14.1+cu130 on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 [cuda:0] (float32 Gram, float64 transform)
